caveats: Google web search (google.com/search) returned a bot check from this network, so local ratings came from Google Maps place pages in the limited (no-JS-login) view. The Maps limited view does not display review counts; counts quoted are from Birdeye pages that mirror Google reviews, except where another source is named.
No contact, quote, booking or sign-up form was submitted anywhere. Vagaro presented an Incapsula bot check and Facebook pages required login, so neither was read; both are noted per business.

Every page title in this browser appeared prefixed with a horse emoji regardless of site (Psychology Today, StyleSeat, Vagaro, Wix, business sites). That is a local browser artefact and was ignored when judging titles.
One business (B00782) is a LifeStance Health office location rather than an independent local practice, and was excluded as a national chain; its scores are included only for completeness.
For B00781 (a mental-health practice) any intake or booking automation recommended would need to be HIPAA-compliant; generic web forms are not appropriate for clinical information.
Where a business had no site, agent-readiness scores reflect the absence of owned, crawlable content rather than a technical failure on a page.
Scores are comparative within this batch of small North Brunswick personal-service businesses, not against other industries.
